basic_details.job_title: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemical Engineering at National Institute of Technology Warangal has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the DRDO-CARS sponsored project "Development of Metal-Organic Framework for Nitrogen-Oxygen Adsorption at Low Temperature and Pressure". The tenure is 18 months and the emoluments are a consolidated INR 45000 per month. The essential qualification is a B.E./B.Tech, M.Sc. or ME/M.Tech/M.S as listed below, and the age limit is 30 Years. The application form and CV must be emailed to [email protected] and [email protected] on or before 29 Novemb

age_limit.details: The age limit is 30 Years. The notice prints no date for counting age. Up to 5 years can be relaxed for SC/ST/OBC/Women and Physically handicapped candidates.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed on page 3 of the notice (Advt. No. NITW/2026/CH/SMM-PKP/CARS-DRDO dated 09/11/2026).
Enclose a copy of the latest CV/Resume (brief resume, curriculum vitae or biodata).
Email the completed form with the CV as a soft copy to [email protected] and [email protected].
Write the subject line as: Application for JRF position under DRDO-CARS project.
Send the email on or before 29/11/2026.

The form asks for name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status, category (OC/OBC/SC/ST), educational qualifications (SSC, Intermediate, B.Sc./B.E./B.Tech, M.Sc./M.Tech.), GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF score, research/industrial/teaching experience, publications, any other relevant information, contact email and phone number. It ends with a signed declaration that the candidate is available for an ONLINE interview, if necessary.
important_instructions: The application form and CV go to both email addresses, [email protected] and [email protected]. Details of the candidate's false or incorrect information, or any ineligibility found before or after selection, may lead to cancellation of candidature, as the declaration states. For queries, contact Dr. Murali Mohan Seepana (Principal Investigator) or Dr. Phani Kumar Pentyala (Co-Principal Investigator), Department of Chemical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Warangal, Telangana State, India, at the same email addresses.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives three alternative essential qualifications. A candidate must meet any one of them. B.E./B.Tech equivalent degree in Chemical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Biotech / Civil / Metallurgy / Petrochemical / Nanotechnology / Energy / Environmental / Polymer engineering / Chemical Technology / Material Science, and ME/M.Tech/M.S in Chemical Engineering / Mechanical / Energy Engineering / Nanotechnology / Biotech / Civil / Environmental Engineering and allied areas, with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG. OR M.Sc. in Chemistry / Physics / Environmental Science / Materials Science / Nanoscience and Nanotechnology or equivalent, with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA at both UG and PG. OR B.Tech. in Engineering with materials related specialization such as Chemical Engineering / Materials Science / Metallurgy / Nanoscience and Nanotechnology or equivalent, with a minimum of 70% aggregate marks or 7.5 CGPA in UG (wherever applicable). Candidates with GATE/NET qualification will be given preference. Those who do not have GATE or NET need to appear for the National Level Examination conducted by the Institute for Ph.D. admission. Candidates with experience in material synthesis, Gas Adsorption, MOF synthesis and membrane preparation related areas are preferred, with knowledge in characterization and analysis, fabrication and project management. The age limit is 30 Years. The notice prints no date for counting age. Up to 5 years can be relaxed for SC/ST/OBC/Women and Physically handicapped candidates. A relaxation of 5% aggregate marks or 0.5 CGPA, for both UG and PG, is given under the SC/ST/PwD category. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed on page 3 of the notice (Advt. No. NITW/2026/CH/SMM-PKP/CARS-DRDO dated 09/11/2026). Enclose a copy of the latest CV/Resume (brief resume, curriculum vitae or biodata). Email the completed form with the CV as a soft copy to [email protected] and [email protected] . Write the subject line as: Application for JRF position under DRDO-CARS project. Send the email on or before 29/11/2026. The form asks for name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status, category (OC/OBC/SC/ST), educational qualifications (SSC, Intermediate, B.Sc./B.E./B.Tech, M.Sc./M.Tech.), GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF score, research/industrial/teaching experience, publications, any other relevant information, contact email and phone number. It ends with a signed declaration that the candidate is available for an ONLINE interview, if necessary.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated through email. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview, which may be ONLINE or OFFLINE. If the interview is online, candidates are expected to have a good internet connection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application form and CV go to both email addresses, [email protected] and [email protected] . Details of the candidate's false or incorrect information, or any ineligibility found before or after selection, may lead to cancellation of candidature, as the declaration states. For queries, contact Dr. Murali Mohan Seepana (Principal Investigator) or Dr. Phani Kumar Pentyala (Co-Principal Investigator), Department of Chemical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Warangal, Telangana State, India, at the same email addresses.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there in the NIT Warangal DRDO-CARS project?
faq.answer: There is 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 29/11/2026, and the application must be sent by email.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice lists three alternatives: B.E./B.Tech with ME/M.Tech/M.S, or M.Sc. in the named science subjects, each with minimum 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA at UG and PG; or B.Tech. with a materials related specialization with minimum 70% or 7.5 CGPA in UG.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 Years. Up to 5 years can be relaxed for SC/ST/OBC/Women and Physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Warangal JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are a consolidated INR 45000 per month, with on-campus Hostel and Mess facilities subject to availability.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the completed application form (page 3 of the notice) with your latest CV/Resume to [email protected] and [email protected]. The subject line must be "Application for JRF position under DRDO-CARS project".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated by email. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview, online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Warangal JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the position is purely temporary, with a duration of 18 Months.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected JRF register for a PhD at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may register for PhD as per institute rules. They must apply for the PhD position when its advertisement is open.
